projectDescription: A full-stack wedding technology platform for Indian destination wedding planners, combining a Wedding CRM for lead and vendor management with an RSVP platform for guest management, check-in, and communication.
keyFeatures: Lead pipeline management with relationship manager assignment and follow-ups
Full wedding project management with multi-function event tracking
Vendor database with ratings, assignments, and follow-up scheduling
SOP-driven checklist engine with templates and per-wedding customization
Client portal with configurable access permissions
Guest RSVP management with tokenized invite links and per-event RSVP status
QR code and manual check-in for event-day attendance tracking
Multi-language digital invite templates (9 Indian languages supported)
Guest communication via WhatsApp, SMS, and Email with automated reminders
Seating chart management with zone-based table assignments
Accommodation room allocation for outstation guests
Photo wall with planner moderation and guest uploads
Live display screen with share tokens for event venues
CRM-RSVP integration with webhook-based real-time sync
Plan tiers (Free, Starter, Professional, Enterprise) with API key support
publicApiSurface: GET /api/weddings — List all weddings for authenticated planner
GET /api/weddings/[weddingId]/guests — List guests for a wedding
POST /api/checkin — Check in a guest at an event
GET /api/guests/[guestToken] — Get guest details by invite token
POST /api/crm/weddings/[id]/webhook — Webhook receiver for CRM notifications
